[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Vegetable Wot Recipe:**  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, 1 onion, chopped, 2 cloves garlic, minced, 1 inch ginger, grated, 1 red bell pepper, diced, 1 can (14.5 oz) diced tomatoes, 1 cup red lentils, rinsed and drained, 2 cups vegetable broth, 1 teaspoon ground cumin, 1 teaspoon ground coriander, 1/2 teaspoon turmeric, salt and black pepper, to taste, 2 tablespoons berbere spice mix, fresh cilantro, chopped (optional).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for Vegetable Wot include heating oil, cooking aromatics, adding lentils and broth, and simmering.
